title: Do zakat funds and welfare need to be developed for the advancement of Bank Muamalat's reputation in the future ?
core_idea: Investigate whether developing and managing zakat and welfare (benevolent) funds can influence Bank Muamalat's reputation by analyzing documentary quantitative data from the bank's 2018–2023 annual reports using PLS-based analysis.
tldr: Quantitative documentary study of Bank Muamalat's 2018–2023 annual reports to assess the relationship between zakat distribution and benevolent fund use and the bank's reputation, to inform whether developing these funds should be pursued to advance reputation.
